    BOCC Meetings & Agendas

    Current Board of County Commissioners Meetings & Agendas

    • Meetings and Agendas, June 2023 to Current
      • Time Approximate for Upcoming BOCC Meeting
      • Meeting agendas are posted one week prior to the meeting, usually between 5 and 11 p.m.
    • Meetings and Agendas, April 2016 to May 2023

    Monroe County Land Authority governing board meetings are held during the regularly scheduled BOCC meetings. The governing board’s agendas are included in the BOCC agendas.

    How to navigate the Meetings and Agendas Page

    • To read the condensed agenda, select “Agenda.”
    • To read the agenda with bookmarked agenda backup: select “Agenda Packet” (This is usually a very large document)
    • To watch a live BOCC meeting with the agenda packet on the same screen: Click the square to the left of the meeting date.
    • To watch a recorded BOCC meeting with the agenda packet available on the same screen: select “Video.”
    • To read the minutes published by the Clerk, select “Minutes.”

    Additional Meeting Viewing Options

    • Monroe County TV - Video on Demand to view past meetings
    • Monroe County TV - Live
    • Television: Comcast 76, AT&T U-Verse 99, Roku
